fields.title: 📖 Osmanî ≠ Khilāfah a Nubuwwah
fields.body:
🖋️ **Pêxember ﷺ, an-Nawawī û al-ʿAynī** gotin:

> ***„Khilāfah a Nubuwwah sih salan didome; paşê Allah padîşahiyê dide yê ku Ew bivê.“***

🌙 **Encam:** Ne her dewleteke mezin a misilman bi xweber Khilāfah an-Nubuwwah e. Deq Khilāfah û Mulk ji hev cuda dikin û Imāmah Kubrā di bingeh de bi Quraysh ve girê didin.

immutable.source: 📝 Abū Dāwūd, as-Sunan, Kitāb as-Sunnah, Bāb fī al-Khulafāʾ, Hadith Nr. 4646; an-Nawawī, Sharḥ Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, Kitāb al-Imārah; al-ʿAynī, ʿUmdat al-Qārī, Kitāb al-Aḥkām.
immutable.book: Sunan Abī Dāwūd / Sharḥ Muslim / ʿUmdat al-Qārī
immutable.scholar: Der Prophet ﷺ, an-Nawawī und al-ʿAynī
